mechanism: Concurrent use of tricyclic antidepressant and MAOI inhibitor risks serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe sympathomimetic potentiation due to impaired monoamine metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; observe 14-day washout period after MAOI discontinuation before starting amitriptyline, or 5-7 days after tricyclic washout before starting MAOI.
